post_title: Has anyone been in this situation? Desperately need help.
concerns_or_questions_summary: Poster filed an H-4 COS and then a new employer filed an H-1B; both were approved the same day with the same I-94 number but different expiry dates (H-1B until 2029, H-4 until 2028). USCIS live agent said H-1B was approved first, suggesting H-4 is the last action, but the H-1B notice itself states COS is granted. The employer rescinded the offer assuming H-4, but if the poster is actually on H-1B their 60-day grace period ends in late May. Three lawyers cannot determine the active status. Asking which status is currently active and how others resolved similar dual same-day approvals.
